name: semantic-search-agent
description: Cross-lingual semantic search agent with Rust WASM core and Google AI Studio load balanced embeddings

scripts.test: npm run test:rust && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:ts: npx --yes tsx ts/tests/provider-contract.test.ts && npx --yes tsx ts/tests/embedding-load-balancer.test.ts && npx --yes tsx ts/tests/e2e-coordinator.test.ts && npx --yes tsx ts/tests/directory-crawler.test.ts
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run test:wasm
scripts.build:wasm: cargo build --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --release && wasm-bindgen --target nodejs --out-dir pkg target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/release/semantic_search_agent.wasm
